note: Literature explicitly notes all pathogenic truncating variants reside in the N-terminal two-thirds, while C-terminal truncating variants predicted to escape NMD remain of uncertain significance.

evidence.text: Schmid et al. identified 25 truncating variants, observing that while other truncating variants were classified as pathogenic/likely pathogenic, the significance of one C-terminal truncating variant predicted to escape nonsense-mediated mRNA decay remained unclear.

source.title: Further delineation of the SCAF4-associated neurodevelopmental disorder
source.quote: While all other truncating variants were classified as pathogenic/likely pathogenic, significance of one C-terminal truncating variant, one splice-site variant and the missense variants remained unclear.

evidence.text: Fliedner et al. reported nine likely pathogenic germline variants (including seven truncating variants) in SCAF4, all of which resided within the N-terminal two-thirds of the protein.

source.title: Variants in SCAF4 Cause a Neurodevelopmental Disorder ...
source.quote: we identified nine likely pathogenic germline variants in SCAF4 including two splice-site and seven truncating variants, all residing in the N-terminal two thirds of the protein.

numbers.metric: truncating variants in N-terminal two thirds
